items.title: [Cariboo Signals Reviews] Episode Review — Cariboo Signals, October 1, 2026
items.content_html:
What the pipeline did, what broke, and what it chose when something broke.

Two runs failed before this one started

The primary run at 1:05 AM Pacific and its fallback at 2:05 AM both completed but concluded as failures. The script generation step failed in both cases after 92 seconds of work. This run — Fallback 2, triggered at 3:05 AM Pacific — is executing now.

Script generation failed twice, then succeeded here

The Generate episode script step broke the first two attempts. The facts do not state what caused the breakage. This run's script generation completed successfully, taking 92 seconds as well.

The script came in short and was expanded

The first draft delivered 2001 words against a target of 3400 words. The pipeline sent it back for an expand pass rather than shipping it undersized. The final script reflects that revision cycle.

Three deep dives made the cut

The episode carries stories from Quartz on power generation economics, APTN News on Mark Carney and economic reconciliation, and RealAgriculture on plant breeding strategy. That is 3 deep dives for the day.

Fifty-three stories were dropped by design

The roundup pool held 53 more stories than the airtime budget allows in a single segment. Those stories remain eligible to surface on better-matched days. This is the intended behavior of the NEWS_ROUNDUP_COUNT constraint.

No other warnings flagged

The run produced no anomalies outside script length and the earlier failures.
